d: Cristiano Ronaldo has announced his retirement from international football, bringing an end to an extraordinary 23-year journey with Portugal.The 41-year-old football legend leaves behind an incredible legacy, with 234 international appearances and 146 goals. He captained Portugal to their historic Euro 2016 triumph and helped the nation win the UEFA Nations League twice. In an emotional farewell message, Ronaldo reflected on his journey, thanked Portuguese fans for their unwavering support and said it was time to pass on the iconic No. 7 shirt to the next generation.
